scope: Mapping of the 8 UAT scenarios in docs/qlda/UAT.md to existing automated tests, and the real CI run that most recently executed them on main.
note: This is automated regression evidence, not a substitute for a human stakeholder UAT session. That session, its feedback and any sign-off remain PENDING_HUMAN.

cited_ci_run.note: Most recent successful required quality CI run on main at the time this mapping was written; main has not changed since.

local_rerun_blocker: This session's sandbox cannot regenerate the Prisma client: `prisma generate` fails fetching a 'linux-nixos' engine binary from binaries.prisma.sh (404), and nixpkgs only ships prisma-engines 6.18.0 against an installed @prisma/client 7.10.1, an incompatible major version. GitHub Actions runs on ubuntu and is unaffected; the CI run cited above is real and verifiable.
